This PR is almost entirely typographic normalization for proselint compliance: converting curly apostrophes (') to straight ASCII (') across five docs files, plus two link changes. The apostrophe conversions are correct and benign. One link change is fine (juju.is → canonical.com/juju is the current canonical Juju site), but the other introduces a broken link (see inline comment). Also note the normalization is incomplete: curly double quotation marks (e.g. “deploy only machines with SSDs” in manage-machine-groups.md) are left intact, so if the goal is full proselint typography compliance these lines will still fail its curly_quotes check.

docs/explanation/security.md.110: The new URL https://wiki.ubuntu.com/Full_Disk_Encryption_Howto_2019 returns HTTP 404. The old Ubuntu community wiki content (help.ubuntu.com/community) was decommissioned, and the page Full_Disk_Encryption_Howto_2019 does not exist on the relaunched wiki.ubuntu.com (verified: fetching the URL 404s, and an on-wiki search for 'full disk encryption' returns no such page; the only related result is Security/FAQ). This change swaps one dead link for another 404 rather than fixing it. Consider linking to the actual new wiki page (e.g. Security/FAQ's FDE guidance) or upstream documentation instead.
